meta.name: Agent Pre-Execution Validation
meta.description: Validate agent is registered, enabled, and active before execution

condition.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> ASK { ?agent a ag:Agent ; ag:enabled true ; ag:status 'active' . }

effect.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> CONSTRUCT { ?agent ag:lastExecuted ?now . ?agent ag:executionCount ?count . } WHERE { ?agent a ag:Agent ; ag:lastExecuted ?prev ; ag:executionCount ?count . BIND(NOW() as ?now) . BIND(?count + 1 as ?count) . }

meta.name: Agent Correction Approval
meta.description: Require approval for critical autonomous corrections

condition.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> ASK { ?correction a ag:Correction ; ag:severity 'critical' ; ag:approved true . }

effect.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> CONSTRUCT { ?correction ag:appliedAt ?now . } WHERE { ?correction a ag:Correction ; ag:severity 'critical' ; ag:approved true . BIND(NOW() as ?now) . }

meta.name: Agent Process Mining Validation
meta.description: Validate process mining claims meet fitness threshold (>= 0.95)

condition.query: PREFIX pm: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/process#> ASK { ?claim a pm:ProcessMiningClaim ; pm:fitness ?fitness . FILTER(?fitness >= 0.95) }

effect.query: PREFIX pm: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/process#> CONSTRUCT { ?claim pm:validated true ; pm:validatedAt ?now . } WHERE { ?claim a pm:ProcessMiningClaim ; pm:fitness ?fitness . FILTER(?fitness >= 0.95) . BIND(NOW() as ?now) . }

meta.name: Agent Multi-Surface Corroboration
meta.description: Require evidence from at least 3 of 5 surfaces (execution, telemetry, state, process, causality)

condition.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> ASK { ?validation a ag:Validation ; ag:surfacesPassed ?count . FILTER(?count >= 3) }

effect.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> CONSTRUCT { ?validation ag:corroborated true . } WHERE { ?validation a ag:Validation ; ag:surfacesPassed ?count . FILTER(?count >= 3) . }

meta.name: Agent Audit Trail Integrity
meta.description: Verify audit trail entries are immutable and correctly chained

condition.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> ASK { ?entry a ag:AuditEntry ; ag:timestamp ?ts ; ag:previousHash ?prev . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?tampered a ag:AuditEntry ; ag:originalHash ?orig ; ag:modifiedHash ?mod . FILTER(?orig != ?mod) } }

effect.query: PREFIX ag: <http://pictl.ai/ontologies/agents#> CONSTRUCT { ?entry ag:integrityVerified true . } WHERE { ?entry a ag:AuditEntry . }
